providers.title: AI Providers
providers.subtitle: Configure BYOK providers by capability — Text, STT, TTS, Image, Embedding (and more later)
providers.onboardingDesc: Providers are grouped by capability, not vendor. Set a workspace default for each capability you use (TEXT for translation/QA, STT for media transcription, TTS for dubbing, IMAGE for visual understanding & generation, EMBEDDING for Translation Memory). Prefer a Recommended preset when available — it fills protocol, base URL and model for you.
providers.sectionTextSubtitle: Providers used for translation, QA, and summarization.
providers.sectionSttSubtitle: Providers used for transcribing audio/video content.
providers.sectionTtsSubtitle: Providers used for generating dubbed audio.
providers.sectionVisionSubtitle: Providers used for understanding images and video frames.
providers.sectionImageSubtitle: Providers used for visual understanding (VLM) and image generation.
providers.sectionVideoSubtitle: Video generation providers for Creative Studio (coming later).
providers.sectionEmbeddingSubtitle: Configure a dedicated embedding endpoint for Translation Memory (vector search & write-back).
providers.systemEmbeddingFallback: Using system embedding fallback — no workspace EMBEDDING default is set. TM vector search/write-back currently uses the system model {{model}} (NVIDIA BGE-M3, 1024 dims). Configure a workspace embedding provider below to override.
providers.futureDesc: This capability section is reserved for a future release. Configuration is not enabled in the current MVP.
providers.formHint: API keys are stored encrypted server-side. Responses only return a masked hint.
providers.emptyDesc: Add a provider before creating documents or batches that need AI processing.
providers.emptyImageDesc: Add an image provider to enable visual understanding and generative media capabilities.
providers.emptyEmbeddingDesc: No workspace EMBEDDING default is set — TM is currently using the system embedding fallback (baai/bge-m3, NVIDIA BGE-M3, 1024 dims). Add a dedicated embedding provider and set it as default to use your own endpoint.
providers.confirmDeleteDefault: This provider is a workspace default for one or more capabilities. Delete it anyway?
providers.confirmDeleteMulti: This provider serves {{capCount}} capabilities ({{capabilities}}).{{defaultClause}} Still delete?
providers.requiredFields: Display name, base URL and model are required
providers.apiKeyRequired: API key is required for a new provider
providers.apiKeyKeep: leave blank to keep current key
providers.capabilitiesHelp: Select every AI feature this endpoint can serve. A single OpenAI-compatible gateway may expose TEXT, STT and TTS together.
providers.capabilitiesTooltip: Capabilities determine which pipeline stages can use this provider.
providers.defaultForHelp: Workspace defaults are resolved per capability. Only mark capabilities this provider should own as the default.
providers.selectCapabilitiesFirst: Select at least one capability above first.

voices.title: TTS voices — {{name}}
voices.description: Only active voices are available for new media jobs. Refresh uses the provider's discovery strategy.
voices.noneForLanguage: No cached voices for {{language}} yet. Use Refresh voices — it syncs the provider's full multilingual catalog, not just this language.
voices.manualHint: OpenAI-compatible providers accept free-form voice IDs such as alloy or nova.
voices.required: Voice ID, display name and language are required.

providers.modePresetHint: Pick a preset to auto-fill protocol, authentication style, base URL and a suggested model. You can still edit fields before saving.
providers.modeCustomHint: Configure any compatible endpoint manually. Use the API root only — never paste a full path such as /chat/completions.
providers.noPresetsForCapability: No presets match this capability yet — switch to Custom provider.
providers.capabilityRequired: At least one capability is required

field.label: Display name
field.displayNameHelp: Human-readable name shown in lists and job configuration screens.
field.displayNameTooltip: A short label for your team — not the vendor product name alone.
field.protocolHelp: Select the API protocol implemented by your endpoint.
field.protocolTooltip: Protocol controls how TransFlow talks to the provider (request shape, headers).
field.baseUrlHelp: The root API endpoint. Do not include specific paths such as /chat/completions, /audio/speech or /embeddings.
field.baseUrlTooltip: API root only — TransFlow appends protocol-specific paths.
field.apiKeyHelp: API credential sent with requests. Stored encrypted; never returned in full.
field.apiKeyTooltip: BYOK credential for this provider. Leave blank on edit to keep the current key.
field.modelHelp: Default model used if no model override is specified on a job or stage.
field.modelTooltip: Suggested model id for this endpoint.
